text:
sara-oncall: Pager triggered — kv-cache-stale impacting long-context streaming in eu-west. ~5-10% of long-generation requests are truncated or timing out. Paging eng-runtime @julia-eng. Investigating now.
incident-bot: Pager: kv-cache-stale (severity: partial degradation). Escalation sent to eng-runtime oncall and ops.
julia-eng: I’m on it. Seeing a spike in KV eviction for sequences > 4096 tokens across eu-west cache nodes. Hypothesis: GC thrash + increased mem working set from recent model roll. Taking diagnostic snapshots and tracing live requests.
mike-ops: Thanks. Can someone draft a short customer-facing status blurb? Need 2 sentences: impact + what we’re doing + guidance.
julia-eng: Tech draft (for ops to simplify): "We are experiencing partial degradation of streaming responses for long-context (>4k token) sessions in eu-west. Some requests may return truncated output or have higher latency. Root cause appears to be a KV cache eviction spike causing cache misses; mitigation: temporarily bumped cache size and rate-limited very-long sessions while we stabilize"
elaine-cs: Customer-friendly version: "We are investigating an issue causing some longer-generation requests in the EU to be incomplete or slower than usual. A temporary mitigation is in place and most requests are returning to normal; we will share another update in ~30 minutes."
mike-ops: Assembled initial status text: "Initial: We are seeing degraded streaming for long-generations in EU-West. A mitigation has been applied and most traffic should recover within 30–45 minutes. If you continue to see issues, please contact support with request IDs and region eu-west." Can legal quick-check? @dan-legal
dan-legal: Quick review done — wording ok. Avoid promising exact ETA, maybe say "expected recovery window".
julia-eng: Executing mitigation: bump cache-size on eu-west pool (rolling restarts of 3 nodes) + temporary rate limit for sessions > 8k tokens. Rolling restart started (node1 -> node3). ETA ~8m to finish rolling restarts.
incident-bot: Action logged: cache-size increased on eu-west; rolling restart initiated.
sara-oncall: I’ll post the initial statuspage update now. Tagging CS for customer DMs.
mike-ops: Published initial status update to status page: https://status.redwood-inference.com/incidents/kv-cache-eviction-eu-west — included the customer-friendly blurb.
elaine-cs: Sending proactive notes to top affected customers with sample troubleshooting (request ids, timestamps).
julia-eng: Update: restarts completed on 3 nodes; eviction rate trending down to baseline. Tail latency improving; still observing ~1% failures for requests > 8k tokens. Collecting 10m of post-mit metrics.
mike-ops: Updating statuspage: "Mitigation in progress — partial recovery observed; continued monitoring. Next update in 15 minutes or on resolution."
incident-bot: Statuspage entry updated.
julia-eng: Final update: KV eviction stabilized after GC parameter tweak + cache bump. No new truncated responses in the last 10 minutes. Rolling back temporary rate limiter.
sara-oncall: Publishing resolved notice now.
mike-ops: Resolved note published on status page and customer DMs sent for impacted customers. Links to updates attached in the incident timeline.
elaine-cs: Follow-up: open postmortem in eng-runtime, include perf graphs (eviction rate, tail latency, GC times), and update autoscaling/alert thresholds for KV cache.
julia-eng: Postmortem doc created and owners assigned (eng-runtime: jh, cc: ops). Will include suggested change: smoother cache autosizing and safer GC params before future model rollouts.
sara-oncall: Thanks all — incident closed from oncall perspective. If anything else crops up, re-open the pager. :white_check_mark:
